verdict.rationale: Klaviyo supports building automations (flows), and its Composer AI says it can 'build marketing for your review' with the user in control. That covers only a thin pre-apply review step for AI-drafted work, and nothing documents versioning or rollback of automations. Missing for 10: automation/flow version history, diff or review workflow for flow changes, rollback to prior versions, export of automation definitions (e.g., via API) for external version control, and independent corroboration.
